_about: Sir Charles Oman (1860-1946): Seven Roman Statesmen of the Later Republic (London: Edward Arnold; first published 1902), raw IA OCR of an impression whose reprint list ends at 1929, so a pre-1930 printing. Oman died 1946. His medieval and Peninsular War histories and The Byzantine Empire are outside this brief. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. The Byzantine Empire (PG 37756) added by lane B, round dk.
